part.name: Hollow cylindrical saddle support
part.description: Single-piece saddle or cradle support with a concave cylindrical seating surface, paired end support lands, an open underside weight-relief pocket, outer side walls, and a planar bottom mounting rim. The model contains one connected CAD solid; no separate functional components are present.
part.symmetry_note: The part is mirror-symmetric about the CAD x=0 and y=0 planes. The two end support regions form a paired pattern about y=0. The cylindrical seating and underside pocket surfaces have axes parallel to the CAD X axis.

semantic_orientation.description: The concave cylindrical surface is interpreted as the functional top seating side and the planar rim at z=-0.75 as the bottom mounting side. Because the part is bilaterally symmetric and lacks directional attachment details, human-semantic front, back, left, and right cannot be assigned reliably.

sections.name: Central saddle body
sections.description: The central load-bearing portion of the part, including the concave cylindrical seat, hollow underside pocket, longitudinal side walls, and bottom mounting rim.
sections.location: Centered about the CAD y=0 plane and extending between the paired end support regions; the seating surface lies above the underside pocket.

section_functions.name: Support a cylindrical member
section_functions.description: Provides the principal saddle-shaped support for a mating cylindrical object.

section_functions.name: Transfer seating load
section_functions.description: Transfers contact load from the cylindrical seat through the walls to the bottom mounting region.

section_functions.name: Reduce body mass
section_functions.description: Uses an underside pocket to remove low-utility central material while retaining a saddle shell.

section_behaviors.name: React seating contact load
section_behaviors.description: The concave surface reacts distributed contact pressure from a supported cylindrical member.

section_behaviors.name: Resist saddle bending
section_behaviors.description: The curved shell and longitudinal walls resist bending between the seat and mounting rim.

section_behaviors.name: Spread load into the base
section_behaviors.description: The walls and mounting rim spread concentrated seating loads into a broader support footprint.

features.name: Compound saddle body
features.description: Compound cradle structure comprising the cylindrical seat, hollow underside pocket, side supports, and bottom mounting interface.

feature_functions.name: Support mating member
feature_functions.description: Integrates the seat and supporting shell into a single load-bearing cradle.

feature_behaviors.name: Resist global bending
feature_behaviors.description: Acts as an integrated curved support structure under transverse seating loads.

relationships.description: The compound cradle contains the cylindrical seating interface.
The compound cradle contains the underside pocket.
The compound cradle contains the paired outer side supports.
The compound cradle contains the bottom mounting rim.

features.name: Concave cylindrical seating interface
features.description: Primary concave cylindrical contact surface spanning the central saddle. CadQuery reports a radius of 4.215 mm and an axis parallel to CAD X.

feature_functions.name: Support cylindrical member
feature_functions.description: Supports and conforms to the lower exterior of a mating cylindrical member.

feature_functions.name: Laterally locate cylindrical member
feature_functions.description: The concave profile provides transverse location of a member resting in the saddle.

feature_behaviors.name: React distributed contact
feature_behaviors.description: Reacts bearing-like contact pressure over the cylindrical seating area.

feature_behaviors.name: Constrain transverse translation
feature_behaviors.description: The curved profile constrains translation transverse to the cylindrical axis while leaving axial motion unconstrained unless supplied by another component.

relationships.description: The seating interface is part of the compound saddle body.
The seating cylinder and pocket-roof cylinder both have axes parallel to CAD X through y=0 and z=4.215.
The seat transfers contact load into the longitudinal side supports.

brep_faces.name: Primary cylindrical saddle face
brep_faces.description: Concave seating face with area 10.213278 mm^2, radius 4.215 mm, origin (0,0,4.215), axis (-1,0,0), and bounding box x=(-1,1), y=(-2.4,2.4), z=(0,0.75).
evidence: CadQuery surface type is CYLINDER.
CadQuery cylinder radius is 4.215 mm.
CadQuery cylinder axis is (-1,0,0).
The face spans the full part width x=(-1,1).
The multi-view images show this face as the dominant concave upper saddle surface.

features.name: Open underside weight-relief pocket
features.description: Open-bottom internal pocket beneath the saddle seat. Its cylindrical roof has radius 4.415 mm and shares the CAD-X-directed axis line of the outer seating cylinder, producing an approximately 0.2 mm radial saddle-shell thickness.

feature_functions.name: Reduce mass
feature_functions.description: Removes material from beneath the saddle while retaining peripheral walls and a mounting rim.

feature_functions.name: Provide underside clearance
feature_functions.description: Provides an open internal volume beneath the saddle shell.

feature_behaviors.name: Maintain shell load path
feature_behaviors.description: The pocket leaves a curved shell and peripheral walls that distribute load around the removed volume.

relationships.description: The pocket is a removal feature within the compound saddle body.
The cylindrical pocket roof and outer seating surface share the axis line through (0,0,4.215) parallel to CAD X.
The pocket opening lies inside the perimeter of the bottom mounting rim.

brep_faces.name: Cylindrical pocket roof
brep_faces.description: Curved cavity roof with area 8.356221 mm^2, radius 4.415 mm, origin (0,0,4.215), axis (-1,0,0), and bounding box x=(-0.8,0.8), y=(-2.461707,2.461707), z=(-0.2,0.55).
evidence: CadQuery surface type is CYLINDER.
Radius 4.415 mm is 0.2 mm larger than the outer saddle radius.
The face is inset to x=(-0.8,0.8) relative to the outer width.
Its position beneath FACE 7 identifies it as the roof of the underside pocket.

brep_faces.name: Negative-Y pocket roof extension
brep_faces.description: Planar cavity boundary at z=0.55 spanning x=(-0.8,0.8) and y=(-2.8,-2.461707).
evidence: CadQuery plane is at z=0.55.
Its x limits match the pocket width.
It joins the negative-Y end of the cylindrical pocket roof.

brep_faces.name: Positive-Y pocket roof extension
brep_faces.description: Planar cavity boundary at z=0.55 spanning x=(-0.8,0.8) and y=(2.461707,2.8).
evidence: CadQuery plane is at z=0.55.
Its x limits match the pocket width.
It mirrors FACE 1 about y=0.

brep_faces.name: Positive-X pocket side wall
brep_faces.description: Longitudinal planar cavity wall at x=0.8 with y=(-2.8,2.8) and z=(-0.75,0.55).
evidence: CadQuery plane is at x=0.8.
The face is inset by 0.2 mm from outer side FACE 10 at x=1.0.
Its vertical extent reaches the open bottom plane.

brep_faces.name: Negative-X pocket side wall
brep_faces.description: Longitudinal planar cavity wall at x=-0.8 with y=(-2.8,2.8) and z=(-0.75,0.55).
evidence: CadQuery plane is at x=-0.8.
The face is inset by 0.2 mm from outer side FACE 12 at x=-1.0.
It mirrors FACE 3 about x=0.

brep_faces.name: Positive-Y pocket end wall
brep_faces.description: Pocket closure wall at y=2.8 spanning x=(-0.8,0.8) and z=(-0.75,0.55).
evidence: CadQuery plane is at y=2.8.
The face lies 0.2 mm inward from the outer end at y=3.0.
Its bounds match the pocket width and depth.

brep_faces.name: Negative-Y pocket end wall
brep_faces.description: Pocket closure wall at y=-2.8 spanning x=(-0.8,0.8) and z=(-0.75,0.55).
evidence: CadQuery plane is at y=-2.8.
The face lies 0.2 mm inward from the outer end at y=-3.0.
It mirrors FACE 5 about y=0.

features.name: Longitudinal side supports
features.description: Paired outer side walls running along the length of the saddle and connecting the curved seat to the bottom rim.

feature_functions.name: Transfer saddle load
feature_functions.description: Transfers load from the curved seat toward the mounting rim.

feature_behaviors.name: Carry compression
feature_behaviors.description: Carries compressive load through the two longitudinal sides.

feature_behaviors.name: Resist longitudinal bending
feature_behaviors.description: The side walls provide section depth and bending stiffness.

relationships.description: The side supports are part of the compound saddle body.
The longitudinal walls support the cylindrical seating interface.
The side walls terminate at and are integral with the bottom mounting rim.

brep_faces.name: Positive-X outer side wall
brep_faces.description: Outer longitudinal side face at x=1.0, spanning y=(-3,3) and z=(-0.75,0.75).
evidence: CadQuery plane is at x=1.0.
The face spans the complete 6 mm part length.
The profile follows the saddle and end-support height changes.

brep_faces.name: Negative-X outer side wall
brep_faces.description: Outer longitudinal side face at x=-1.0, spanning y=(-3,3) and z=(-0.75,0.75).
evidence: CadQuery plane is at x=-1.0.
The face spans the complete 6 mm part length.
It mirrors FACE 10 about x=0.

features.name: Bottom mounting rim
features.description: Planar bottom footprint surrounding the open pocket. The two-wire topology indicates an outer bottom boundary and the internal pocket opening.

feature_functions.name: Mount saddle to support
feature_functions.description: Provides a planar underside interface for seating or mounting the saddle on another structure.

feature_functions.name: Transfer load to foundation
feature_functions.description: Transfers loads from the side and end supports into an external supporting surface.

feature_behaviors.name: React base contact
feature_behaviors.description: Provides planar contact around the pocket opening.

feature_behaviors.name: Spread base load
feature_behaviors.description: The peripheral rim spreads support loads around the underside pocket.

relationships.description: The mounting rim is part of the compound saddle body.
The bottom rim surrounds the open-bottom pocket.
The bottom rim supports the longitudinal side walls at the mounting plane.

brep_faces.name: Planar bottom mounting face
brep_faces.description: Bottom planar rim at z=-0.75 with area 3.04 mm^2, bounding box x=(-1,1), y=(-3,3), and two boundary wires.
evidence: CadQuery plane is at the minimum model coordinate z=-0.75.
The face spans the full outer footprint.
Two wires are reported, consistent with a rim around the open pocket.
The planar underside is suitable as a seating or mounting interface.

sections.name: Paired end support regions
sections.description: Mirror-equivalent raised end regions at the two longitudinal ends of the saddle. Each region includes a planar upper land and a full-width outer end wall.
sections.location: At the two ends of the central saddle, near CAD y=-3 and y=3.

section_functions.name: Support saddle ends
section_functions.description: Provides raised terminal support material adjacent to both ends of the cylindrical seating surface.

section_functions.name: Transfer end loads
section_functions.description: Transfers loads at the ends of the seating region into the base structure.

section_behaviors.name: Carry terminal compression
section_behaviors.description: The end blocks carry compression between their upper lands and the bottom support plane.

section_behaviors.name: Stiffen saddle ends
section_behaviors.description: The raised end material stiffens the transitions at both ends of the curved seat.

feature_groups.name: Paired end support lands
feature_groups.pattern_description: Two mirror-equivalent end support features located at opposite CAD-Y ends and related by reflection about y=0.

features.name: Negative-Y end support
features.description: Raised support region at the negative CAD-Y end, including its planar upper land and outer end wall.

feature_functions.name: Support negative-Y saddle end
feature_functions.description: Provides terminal support and a planar upper land adjacent to the curved seat.

feature_behaviors.name: Carry compression
feature_behaviors.description: Carries load through the terminal block toward the bottom mounting plane.

relationships.description: The negative-Y end support is integral with the central saddle body.
Its upper land is adjacent to the negative-Y termination of the cylindrical seat.
The two end supports are mirror-aligned about the CAD y=0 plane.
